description: This file contains unit tests for the WebChatMainSessionKey functionality of the OpenClaw project. It tests the behavior of extracting the main session key from a JSON configuration, including fallback and trimming logic.

classes.name: WebChatMainSessionKeyTests
classes.description: A structure containing test methods to verify the behavior of main session key extraction from configuration JSON.

methods.name: config get snapshot main key falls back to main when missing
methods.description: Test that verifies the fallback to 'main' when the main key is missing in the configuration.

methods.name: config get snapshot main key trims and uses value
methods.description: Test that verifies trimming and usage of the main key when present.

methods.name: config get snapshot main key falls back when empty or whitespace
methods.description: Test that verifies fallback when main key is empty or whitespace.

methods.name: config get snapshot main key falls back when config null
methods.description: Test that verifies fallback when the entire config is null.

methods.name: config get snapshot uses global scope
methods.description: Test that verifies usage of global scope if specified in the config.
